chapter one · us being us
🐻‍❄️🍀

Welcome to our little world.

It's got two slightly chaotic people, a lot of bickering, random laughs, cute moments and one girl who deserves approximately 1000 sunflowers.

I love that we can be silly, tease each other, make memories out of ordinary days and somehow make the smallest moments feel special. 💚
chapter two · my favourite human
🌻🐰

Things that are so you.

Your sunflower-loving heart, your hard work, your expressions (especially that one angry face hehe), your little details and the way you care so deeply.

And me? I'm still the guy who likes annoying you, making you laugh and being ridiculously happy that I get to call you my girl. 💚
a little note · from me to you
💌🌿

Hey, my Swathi.

Out of all the things I could keep, I think I'd keep these little moments with you. The smiles, the silly faces, the photos, the bickering and all the ordinary things that became our memories.

I'm sorry for the moments I could've handled better. I'm learning, and I want my actions to show that. But today, I mostly wanted to make something that reminds you how much I adore us.

I'm proud of you, I'm cheering for you, and I hope we keep making many more memories at our own pace.

— your Vishnu 💚
